CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately

----
